gate.name: vscode
gate.description: Classify the type of task in a VS Code issue by its primary intent

classes.label: accessibility
classes.description: Screen reader compatibility, WCAG contrast violations, keyboard navigation, ARIA semantics, or assistive technology support in VS Code
utterances: fix edit fields in the issue reporter missing accessible labels for NVDA screen reader
fix VoiceOver not announcing the Dictation Introduction dialog when it opens
fix Mermaid diagrams frequently violating WCAG colour contrast requirements
add screen reader announcement for next edit suggestions (NES) inline edits
fix Go to Line/Column dialog having no line number visible to NVDA in the edit box
fix NES gutter indicator being focusable but having no role, no accessible name, and no keyboard operation
use ARIA status instead of alert for terminal live updates to reduce screen reader noise
fix High Contrast theme selection indicator being nearly invisible in the IntelliSense pop-up

classes.label: agent-chat
classes.description: Copilot Chat agent mode behavior, tool definitions, model selection, context injection, search problems, OTel, or session management
utterances: run_factory should not accept an unconstrained factory name causing serial retry failures
raise or make configurable the hard 200-result cap in Copilot grep_search
fix Copilot refusing to analyze attached text files claiming they are not in the workspace
fix Multi-Root Workspace glob and file search not working due to hardcoded ** prefix
fix Reload not maintaining the agent harness choice, always reverting to Local
fix Copilot silently corrupting long attached files by summarizing them without warning
fix active editor file silently injected as editorContext causing unintended cross-project context switches
add support in VS Code for Agent Client Protocol (ACP) for 3rd party agent CLI integration

classes.label: agent-sandbox
classes.description: Copilot agent sandbox feature: bubblewrap, network isolation, approval rules, filesystem permissions, or Docker/container access
utterances: terminal sandbox bypasses approval rules making it impossible to enforce command restrictions
support enableWeakerNetworkIsolation in agent sandbox for macOS trustd certificate verification
fix sandboxed agent terminal commands failing in Linux devcontainers due to missing user namespaces
fix sandbox settings being written into a write-allowed location the agent can edit
the fetch_webpage tool becomes unusable when agent sandboxing is enabled due to network domain policy
fix CLI reporting broken pty.node when sandbox is enabled on Linux
add a clear UI affordance to manage sandbox mode and exit the sandbox
fix sandbox dependency installation failing on apt systems without updated package metadata

classes.label: ubb
classes.description: Usage-Based Billing: AI credit consumption, quota management, cost display, billing telemetry, model pricing, or plan upgrades in Copilot
utterances: add per-session AI credit budget to prevent catastrophic cost explosions from runaway agents
fix session cost not accounting for subagent credit consumption in the cost indicator
nudge EDU/Student users to Copilot Pro instead of Pro+ when limits are reached
fix Copilot Chat auto-switching to 1M context after VS Code restart, ignoring selected model
add telemetry for consumption checkpoint banners to track user engagement
show AI credits used when no ULB is set for users in organizations without billing limits
provide session-level token usage data similar to Copilot CLI /usage command
add cache_write_price display in the Cost column of the Models management UI

classes.label: wsl
classes.description: Windows Subsystem for Linux integration: WSL path handling, terminal issues, remote connections, WSL-specific bugs or feature requests
utterances: fix directory from last WSL install not being remembered correctly
fix Node v24 exec format error in WSL 1 due to unsupported binary architecture
fix VS Code trying to update WSL on launch for no reason when WSL is already installed
fix VS Code maximized window shifted right and bottom on WSL2 Linux
fix pipe to `code -` not working in WSL remote sessions
fix GitHub Copilot Agent being unable to execute commands in WSL/bash terminals, only PowerShell supported
fix terminal suggest showing absolute completions from local C: drive in remote WSL windows
fix VS Code extension server restarting frequently on WSL after recent updates

classes.label: api
classes.description: VS Code Extension API surface: new API proposals, API bugs, extension points, TreeView, webview, language model, or terminal APIs
utterances: add support for contributable chat context resources in the Chat API
provide an API to track a document position across edits for live location references
expose document tokenization with theme-resolved token colors for extension use
allow extensions to add coloured markers in the gutter similar to source control decorations
add support for webview.hide() and webview.collapse() in the Extension API
add model visibility hide/show APIs to vscode.lm namespace for BYOK providers
finalize the tooltip API for QuickPickItem to show additional information
allow extensions to create terminals adjacent to a parent terminal without splitting
